correctness.rationale: For n>=3, 2<=k<n and m>=2|k, the gaps of S=<n,n+1,...,n+k> are precisely intervals [t(n+k)+1,(t+1)n-1] for t=0,...,L-1 with L=ceil((n-1)/k). Comparing to blocks [tn+1,(t+1)n-1] deletes tk/m of each residue, yielding N_r=count(1<=x<Ln;x=r mod m)-count(1<=t<L;tn=r mod m)-(k/m)*C(L,2). For gcd(n,m)=1, both uncorrected counts have spread <=1, hence sharp spread <=2; explicit n=2m-1,k=m achieves 2 for m>=4. Polynomial cyclic derivative shows equidistribution iff gcd(n,m)=1 and (n=1 mod m or L=0 mod m), using nontrivial proper cyclic arcs without translation symmetry. Special m=2,3 and m|n cases follow by explicit incomplete-block/resonance counts. All statements require m|k.
residual_risks: General proof depends on interval filling and cyclic arc argument; finite DP cannot prove the unbounded statement.
The m=2 absolute spread-zero remark is limited to coprime regime, as explicitly distinguished from m|n.
